top_risks.label: MUD LOSS RISK
top_risks.recommended_action: Pre-treat mud with fine/medium LCM, reduce ECD by lowering flow rate and keep LCM pills staged before entering the interval.

top_risks.label: KICK RISK
top_risks.recommended_action: Raise mud weight to the recommended value before the transition, flow-check every connection, slow-drill the top 30 m and confirm BOP test status. Recommended mud weight before Kopili: 13.3 ppg (pore pressure up to 12.9 ppg).

top_risks.label: TIGHT HOLE RISK
indicators: Increasing torque trend (+14% over last 100 m)
why: Increasing torque trend (+14% over last 100 m)
top_risks.recommended_action: Improve hole cleaning with hi-vis sweeps, back-ream on trips and switch to an inhibitive mud system across reactive clays.

top_risks.label: TORQUE SPIKE RISK
indicators: Pack-off tendency while drilling coal seams
Increasing torque trend (+14% over last 100 m)
why: Increasing torque trend (+14% over last 100 m)
top_risks.recommended_action: Step WOB and RPM down before the interval, run a wiper trip to condition the hole and raise the lubricity of the mud system.

top_risks.label: STUCK PIPE RISK
indicators: Increasing torque trend (+14% over last 100 m)
why: Increasing torque trend (+14% over last 100 m)
top_risks.recommended_action: Increase circulation before connections, ream every stand through the interval, keep jars armed and spot a lubricant pill on any torque rise.

top_risks.label: FISHING RISK
top_risks.recommended_action: Verify fishing tools on location, limit overpull to string design and avoid dry drilling through hard stringers.
